'''Rehkta''' was a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who held the position of [[War Chief]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He and his tamed [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] when they attacked offworlders who were [[Raid on Rakata Prime|pursuing]] the [[Order of Revan]].<ref name="Legacy of the Rakata" />
